# FLX-2117: a run file is a link or is not a regular file

**Family:** plan/replay binding (the 2000 band)

The engine appends to some files of a run in place, and it reads others back to digest or to report on. It does neither through a link: a name that is a symbolic link, a directory, a pipe or a device is not the file the engine wrote, and following it would write to, or report on, some other path. The type is checked on the open descriptor, after the open, so a name swapped between a check and the open cannot slip through. Remove the entry named in the message, or delete the run directory and run `fluxsim plan` again. The files the engine writes whole are replaced rather than refused, so a link at one of those names is overwritten without its target being touched.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-2117
```

Every code is listed in the [error index](./README.md).
